description.value:
Frequency Once per ten minutes

You inscribe names, titles or symbols that represent your party or individual members into the air for all onlookers to see in a space up to 60 feet away, though you may also use fake or misleading ones if you need to instead conceal your true identities.  When you inscribe these symbols, you create a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] as the inscription appears overhead that persists for 1 minute. As you do, you roll a @Check[society|against:will] check against the Will DC of creatures you are aware of that can see the inscription that you want the proclamation to make an impression on.

As part of inscribing, choose one of the following embellishments, which grants you or allies affiliated with the inscription a benefit as long as they remain in the burst:

  • Embellishment of Justice: When an affected ally deals damage to an enemy, they add 5 persistent fire, spirit, force or mental damage to the damage roll, chosen when selecting this embellishment.

  • Embellishment of Resolve: When an affected ally receives healing or heals another creature, they gain a +5 status bonus to the amount of hit points healed.

  • Embellishment of Courage: When an affected ally would take damage, they gain resistance 5 to the damage. If multiple types of damage apply, select one.

If your Society check succeeds against a creature you intend to impress, they will affiliate an ally who benefits from the inscription with it, potentially providing circumstance bonuses at a GM’s discretion, such as with Diplomacy checks (if the inscription exemplifies an ally’s qualities truthfully) or Deception checks (if the inscription was meant to mislead or hide their true identities).
